rules.trigger: No active canonical game id ends in -v1.
rules.first_generation: 50 -> 60 by adding 10 genuinely new runnable v1 seeds
rules.later_generations: Repeat only after every v1 introduced by the preceding generation has been glow-upped.
rules.ledger_boundary: Never edit the 1,000-row q/gpt provenance ledgers; new s-series concepts are recorded only here.
rules.activation: A generation is added atomically only after every seed has metadata, source, thumbnail, deterministic win/loss traces, schema validation, novelty evidence, and a structural clone audit.
